risks: Technology Risk: Rapid technological changes may result in existing solutions becoming obsolete.
Competition Risk: Highly competitive sectors including established global technology companies and emerging enterprises.
Capital Intensity: AI data centre infrastructure involves substantial capital expenditure; availability and cost of capital may influence ability to scale.

Power and Infrastructure Risk: AI data centres require significant and reliable power supply; availability, cost and quality of power, cooling and other infrastructure may impact operating costs and project viability.

Semiconductor Supply Chain Risk: Global supply-chain constraints, manufacturing concentration, geopolitical developments, transportation disruptions and fluctuations in component availability and pricing.
Cybersecurity and Data Privacy: Cybersecurity incidents, data breaches, system failures or unauthorized access could adversely affect operations, reputation and customer relationships.
Regulatory Risk: Evolving regulatory environment relating to AI, data protection, cybersecurity, semiconductors and digital infrastructure may affect operations and investment decisions.
Talent Risk: Competition for skilled professionals in AI and semiconductor technologies may affect ability to recruit and retain qualified personnel.
Employee Health and Safety risk impacting productivity
Business Ethics risk leading to loss of reputation and financial losses
Data Privacy risk leading to legal issues, financial penalties, and loss of trust

outlook.statement: The management believes that increasing enterprise adoption of AI, growth in digital workloads and continued investments in computing infrastructure provide a favorable long-term environment for the Company's business.

Following the change in management and control, the Company has proposed to focus on the Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry, including opportunities in AI Data Centres, Semiconductors and AI Technology Services. The Company intends to progressively develop and expand its business in these areas; however, no specific time-bound commitments, goals or targets have been formally defined as on the date of this Report.

litigation: No application made and no proceeding pending under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 during Financial Year 2025-26.
No significant and material orders passed by regulators or courts or tribunals impacting going concern status and operations.

BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited levied fines for non-compliance under Regulation 17 of Listing Regulations for quarters ended December 2023 and March 2024. Fines: INR 1,35,700/- and INR 4,72,000/- respectively by each exchange. Company submitted waiver applications.
